🎟️ Festivals

🍖 Food bag

Click to eat. Raw food can be cooked at the inn or a Merchant's Camp campfire.

💎 Gem bag

Click a gem to socket it into your gear (the first open socket). Shift+click sells one, right-click moves one into your backpack (to mail or store it). Mira combines and cuts gems.

🪨 Rune bag

Take two rune stones to a blacksmith to engrave a runeword on your weapon. Shift+click sells one, right-click moves one into your backpack.

🌱 Seed pouch

Shared by your whole family. Plant them at the farm east of your house in Emberhold.

🗝️ Key ring

📜 Scroll bag

Click to read. Scrolls are found in chests and on monsters, and one or two Return Scrolls hide on every floor.
